title: Raster, Mask, Texture, Blend, Symbol, Stamp, Scatter & Reusable Component Studio
objective: Implement the map-specific paint/place substrate over the completed MCS authoring foundation: raster/texture brushes, erase/masks/fills/gradients/blends, tileable textures, ARI/MAI symbol/stamp/component palettes, brush-along-path placement, seeded scatter/density/randomization and custom authorized map art without replacing generic image/vector kernels or canonical owner authorities.

scope.purpose: Provide map-specific raster, mask, texture and reusable symbol/stamp/scatter authoring over MCS identities and lawful ARI/MAI asset references while preserving generic DCC/image kernels and canonical game/world authority.
included: erase, masks, fills, gradients and blends
ARI/MAI symbol, stamp and reusable component palettes
scope.completion_gate: Representative MCS documents can deterministically author raster/mask/texture layers and place reusable authorized symbols/stamps/components with seeded scatter and inspectable provenance while canonical World/Scene/game truth and generic asset authorities remain unchanged.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json were reconsulted after MCS-05 exact-tree publication. No cross-program rotation detour supersedes the surviving MCS strict order; MCS-07 is the next selected tranche.
MCS-05 consumes MCS-01/MCS-03 document, layer, object and editing foundations and authors MCS projections only.
ARI/MAI remain identity, rights/provenance and map-asset/package authorities; custom map art and component palettes use authorized asset references rather than minting replacement asset authority.
Generic image/vector/DCC kernels remain external/library capabilities where practical; MCS-05 supplies map-specific authoring behavior rather than rebuilding general-purpose editors.
MCS-07, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work were not started by this execution.
next_action: MCS-05 is closed. MCS-07 is selected_not_started; wait for a later owner Continue before granting MCS-07 implementation authority.
